title: My Hero Academia
description: Boku no Hero AcademiaIn a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered Quirk, Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that won’t stop him from enrolling in a prestigious hero academy. Now, he’ll get his first taste of brutal rivalry from other schools as he braves the cutthroat, no-holds-barred provisional license exam.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 0 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: UA's sophomore students are undergoing targeted training to prepare for their provisional license exams, and today they will have to take part in a rescue operation. This is just a simulation, but teamwork will be required in order to succeed in the exercise. Except that as soon as the mission begins, a landslide changes the game. The ten students who had split into several groups find themselves trapped by debris. Is this accident part of the exercise? Will the students come out of it unharmed? The survival test has just begun.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 0 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: It's been ten months since Izuku en-rolled at U.A. High School, and on top of his regular school work, four days a week he has been continuing his Hero Work-Study at the Endeavor Agency. On one day, they are approached by a police officer, seeking assistance in tracking down a local graffiti artist vandalizing the streets.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 0 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The "Hero League Baseball" is an organization set-up by several Pro Heroes to allow them the chance to play and compete in their spare time. For this year, the "Orcas", led by Gang Orca, and the "Lionels", led by Shishido, have made it to the finals. Present Mic narrates the game, accompanied by an extremely apathetic Eraser Head.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 0 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A are bored out of their minds! Stuck in their dorms during the winter season, they can't go out or do anything fun. That is until third year Mirio Togata pays the students a visit with a new card game the support course developed that uses U.A. students as playable characters. Now to pass the time, they'll play this game that's just as tough as U.A. Who will win the card battle?!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 0 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: In preparation for the provisional license exam, UA's 10th grade students are participating in a simulated rescue, but the rescue has gone wrong and the students are now trapped in an underground shopping mall. As if the situation wasn't complicated enough, water starts seeping through the walls. The students have to get out of here as soon as possible. That said, Bakugo still takes the mission very seriously and refuses to go out without finding and evacuating the rescue dummy. The water is rising dangerously. Will they be able to evacuate and avoid the disaster?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x1
episodes_data.description: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x2
episodes_data.description: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might’s secret, but there’s trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x3
episodes_data.description: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x4
episodes_data.description: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x5
episodes_data.description: It’s Izuku’s first day of high school, and he still can’t control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x6
episodes_data.description: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x7
episodes_data.description: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x8
episodes_data.description: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x9
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x10
episodes_data.description: Villains have attacked USJ, and it’s up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x11
episodes_data.description: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x12
episodes_data.description: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 1x13
episodes_data.description: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x1
episodes_data.description: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x2
episodes_data.description: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x3
episodes_data.description: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x4
episodes_data.description: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x5
episodes_data.description: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x6
episodes_data.description: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x7
episodes_data.description: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x8
episodes_data.description: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x9
episodes_data.description: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x10
episodes_data.description: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x11
episodes_data.description: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x12
episodes_data.description: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x13
episodes_data.description: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x14
episodes_data.description: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x15
episodes_data.description: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x16
episodes_data.description: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x17
episodes_data.description: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x18
episodes_data.description: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x19
episodes_data.description: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x20
episodes_data.description: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x21
episodes_data.description: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x22
episodes_data.description: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x23
episodes_data.description: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x24
episodes_data.description: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 2x25
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x1
episodes_data.description: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x2
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x3
episodes_data.description: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x4
episodes_data.description: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x5
episodes_data.description: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x6
episodes_data.description: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x7
episodes_data.description: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x8
episodes_data.description: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x9
episodes_data.description: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x10
episodes_data.description: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x11
episodes_data.description: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x12
episodes_data.description: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x13
episodes_data.description: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x14
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x15
episodes_data.description: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x16
episodes_data.description: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x17
episodes_data.description: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x18
episodes_data.description: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x19
episodes_data.description: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x20
episodes_data.description: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x21
episodes_data.description: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x22
episodes_data.description: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x23
episodes_data.description: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x24
episodes_data.description: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia 3x25
episodes_data.description: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 4 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: There's an emergency drill at U.A. High School, and Class 1-A is requested to report for duty!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After their fight with the Nomu, Hawks and Endeavor return to daily life, and Izuku dreams of One For All…

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: It's still anybody's game as the the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work study students with the next steps in their training.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Memories from Shigaraki's past as Tenko Shimura resurface as he confronts Re-Destro.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 5 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Using the information Hawks gathered, the heroes and their work study students get ready for an attack on the Paranormal Liberation Front led by Shigaraki.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: As Endeavor and the others fight the Nomus at the hospital, Mirko goes against Kyudai Garaki's best soldiers, the High-Ends. Meanwhile, Kaminari steels his resolve to save those he cares about and goes to the front line of team Edgeshot.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Inside Gunga Villa, the Paranormal Liberation Front realizes that they are under attack, and Twice confronts Hawks about his betrayal.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: An enraged Dabi confronts Hawks after Twice's death, meanwhile at the Hospital Endeavor, Eraser head, Crust, Present Mic and X-less finally arrive to help Mirko, who's risking her life to stop Shigaraki's awakening.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The fight against the High-End Nomus in Jaku Hospital continues however they are unaware that Tomura Shigaraki has awakened. Whilst this is happening, Tokoyami flies in to try and save Hawks from Dabi.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Gigantomachia and the rest of the Paranormal Liberation Front gain the upper hand at the Gunga Mountain Villa as the newly awakened Tomura Shigaraki finds a new objective; steal One for All from Izuku Midoriya.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The fight against Shigaraki continues while other heroes fight the new Nomus that Shigaraki summoned. While this is happening Team Edgeshot tries to stop Gigantomachia from making it to Jaku City.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The pro heroes' defensive net was broken through. Facing the monstrous giant are the U.A. hero course students. Class A and Class B work together to start a big operation to block Gigantomachia.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As Aizawa seems to be out of the battle, Midoriya tries to keep Shigaraki in the air utilizing all of his quirks. Knowing his limit is near, Bakugo comes up with a plan to help him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Shigaraki's attack pierced right through Kacchan. Deku loses himself to his rage and thrust himself to Shigaraki. However, things change suddenly. In the world of One For All, Deku stand against Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: As Ochaco and Toga exchange words and blows, Gigantomachia reaches Shigaraki and the heroes, and Dabi reveals the secret of his past.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Best Jeanist appears and spins together the hopes of all the heroes in this fight as the climax of the all-out war draws near.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Thinking of his great-great-grandfather, Mr. Compress performs his greatest trick in order to save the League of Villains.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The heroes wrestle with changing public opinion as they deal with the aftermath of the fierce battle and mourn those they lost in the fight.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Under All For One's control, Shigaraki attacks Tartarus with the Nomus to free All For One's body, freeing many other prisoners in the process.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: As heroes deal with criticism from the public, Hawks thinks back on his past with his family, and Endeavor's family visits him in the hospital.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Endeavor and his family reflect on Toya's past and the events that led to his death, and Hawks and Best Jeanist bring them a proposition.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Inside One For All, Izuku talks with the past wielders as the top three heroes deal with public sentiment after Dabi's revelation.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: After Izuku decides not to go back to U.A., he finds himself facing Muscular, who was broken out of jail, again and uses the Quirks of the past wielders against him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The top three heroes continue to face criticism as they deal with jailbreakers and look for hints about All For One and Shigaraki's whereabouts, and Izuku comes across a villain from Tartarus.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: During Izuku's fight with Lady Nagant, she tells him secrets about hero society that further solidify his resolve to help those who need his help.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: As Izuku goes off alone in his quest for justice, his classmates realize something is wrong and try to find a way to help him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: As Deku tries to run away, Class A draws him back by recounting their memories with him and reminding him of his own words.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: As the evacuees at U.A. voice their dissent, Ochaco speaks up to try and sway them. Onlookers with ties to Izuku try to figure out if it's time for them to speak out, too.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 6 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: As Izuku tries to rest and recover back at U.A. with his classmates, All Might has an encounter with Stain that leads to new information about Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: As jailbreakers run rampant in Japan, Star and Stripe flies from the U.S. to Japan to help and finds Shigaraki waiting for her in the middle of her flight path.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: The fight between Star and Stripe and Shigaraki is coming to an end, but Star has one more trick up her sleeve with New Order.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After failing to steal Star's Quirk, New Order, and losing many other Quirks, Shigaraki and All For One prepare for their next move. Who is the traitor at U.A.?!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Due to his relationship with All For One, Yuga Aoyama calls himself a villain, but Deku tells him that he can still be a hero and reaches a hand out to him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As heroes and villains get ready for the coming battle, Deku and the others leave U.A., and Deku is called out by Aoyama, who is supposed to be in a police cell. What does Aoyama want?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: It's finally time for the decisive battle between heroes and villains! The plan by All Might, Aizawa, and the others has them start their fights in various places around Japan!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Even though Shigaraki's Quirks are sealed, he attacks Bakugo and the others with a strange new appearance and power. Meanwhile, Deku is pulled to where Toga was warped and Todoroki and Dabi face off!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Eleven years ago, Toya Todoroki was burned by his own flames and became Dabi. Todoroki faces Dabi's blue flames with a new move of his own. Will he be able to stop his brother?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Shoto Todoroki stopped Dabi with his Great Glacial Aegir, and reports of that bolstered the spirits of the heroes fighting in other locations. And Shoto and Dabi's father, Endeavor, is facing the greatest evil, All For One, with Hawks!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Before the threat of All For One, Endeavor falls, and Hawks, Jiro, and Tokoyami are also cornered. Even so, Jiro acts like a hero! Endeavor is also encouraged after looking back at his own life.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Bakugo's Howitzer Impact didn't work against Shigaraki/All For One, either, and Bakugo is pushed into a corner by Shigaraki's power and words. In order to get him out of that predicament, U.A.'s Big Three take a stand!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Bakugo surprised Shigaraki/All For One with Cluster but was then cruelly pierced through. The heroes in all the different locations are getting pushed back... But even so, they will not give up!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Deku finally arrives at the Coffin in the Sky! Seeing Bakugo and the others defeated by Shigaraki/All For One, Deku shakes with anger. Can he control his feelings and win against Shigaraki? It's finally time for a showdown!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: Spinner takes heteromorphs who are exploding with resentment from being persecuted to Central Hospital to get Kurogiri back. Shoji, whose Quirk also makes him a heteromorph, shouts his feelings to them.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Spinner and Present Mic both yell their hearts out. Will the one waking up to their voices be Kurogiri, or Shirakumo? Meanwhile, fighting Ochaco and the others on Okuto Island, Toga is finally going to use her secret weapon...!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Toga consumed Twice's blood, and with Kurogiri's Warp, infinite doubles of Twice appear. Shigaraki's Decay is also released, and the heroes seem to be in a state of despair. But then, help comes from an unexpected quarter...

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: With the addition of Gentle, La Brava, and Lady Nagant, Deku is able to restrain Shigaraki's hands and confront him on the ground. Meanwhile, at the Gunga Villa site, the rewound All For One shows off his awful power...

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Shishikura and the other members of Shiketsu High join the fight at the Gunga Villa site, and it's do-or-die as the heroes unite to fight back! But as All For One gets younger, he gets stronger. That's when unexpected backup arrives...!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Trampling the heroes, All For One flies to become one with Shigaraki, and Dabi is about to explode with the heat he's been storing up in his body. Will the Symbol be able change this hopeless situation?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Toga transforms into Twice and backs the heroes into a corner with Infinite Doubles. In the midst of that, Ochaco does her best to get close to Toga to talk to her. How does Toga respond...?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 7 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Toga returns the smile of Ochaco, who tried to be friends with her. What does Toga do to the seriously-injured Ochaco? Meanwhile, All Might uses "power" developed by a friend to face All For One!

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

episodes_data.title: My Hero Academia Season 8 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?
